statement: A signed batch is final at its nonce: anyone can land it (possibly as a no-op), so a replacement is always signed at a fresh nonce (widens R-NONCE).

killers.name: R-FINAL-NONCE a failed batch does not replay: the same signed batch at the consumed nonce reverts
abort and R-FINAL-NONCE: a batch given up on stays signed and its nonce is never signed again
